values.note: Rustic family campsites (no hookups) $25/day per site for Bucks County residents, $50 for non-residents; up to 6 people and 2 tents per site. Card payments add a $1.50 to 2.35% convenience fee; $10 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://secure.rec1.com/PA/bucks-county-pa-parks-recreation/catalog (Camping tab, rendered: 'Bucks County Residents Family Campsites: $25/day per site', 'Non-Residents Family Campsites: $50/day per site', 'Rentals are accepted only for the current calendar year'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 22 family or individual campsites plus 2 group camping areas and 4 cabins. Travel homes up to 25 ft and trailers up to 18 ft at specified sites; one unit and two vehicles per site.

values.note: Reserve on Bucks County Parks' Rec1 catalog (Camping tab) or call 215-757-0571; only the current calendar year is bookable. Check-in after 3 pm, check-out before 2 pm. Cancel in writing 7 business days ahead ($10 fee). No pets or alcohol.

summary: Confirmed $25 resident / $50 non-resident, no hookups, dump station, 25-ft motorhome limit (trailers 18), reservable online, 14-day limit. Added 22 family sites, no water/sewer, the Rec1 booking link and current-year-only window. Not stated: campground season (comfort stations close Nov 15 - Apr 15 county-wide; the pool is Memorial Day - Labor Day).
